question: What is this platform and how does it work?
answer: Our platform is an all-in-one digital productivity and collaboration service designed to streamline workflows, manage projects, and communicate seamlessly across distributed teams. You can get started by creating a free account, creating a workspace, and inviting your colleagues.

question: How do I create a new account?
answer: Click the 'Sign Up' button on the top right corner of the homepage. You can register using your Google or Microsoft work account, or sign up with an email address and a secure password. Verify your email to activate your account.

question: Is there a free trial available?
answer: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial on our Pro plan with full access to all premium features. No credit card is required to begin your trial period.

question: What are the system requirements to use the platform?
answer: Our web application works on modern desktop and mobile browsers including Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Apple Safari, and Microsoft Edge. For mobile devices, native apps are available for iOS (version 15+) and Android (version 10+).

question: How do I invite team members to my workspace?
answer: Go to Workspace Settings > Members > Invite Members. Enter your colleagues' email addresses, choose their permission level (Admin, Member, or Guest), and click 'Send Invites'.

question: How do I reset my account password?
answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your registered email address, and click submit. You will receive an email with a secure reset link valid for 60 minutes. Click the link and enter your new password.

question: How do I enable two-factor authentication (2FA)?
answer: Navigate to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. Toggle 'Enable 2FA', scan the QR code with an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator, 1Password, or Authy), and enter the 6-digit confirmation code.

question: Can I change my registered email address?
answer: Yes. Go to Account Settings > Profile > Email. Enter your new email address and current password. A verification link will be sent to your new email address to confirm the update.

question: How do I permanently delete my account?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Privacy > Delete Account. Please note that deleting your account is irreversible and permanently removes your profile, files, projects, and personal data.

question: Why is my account locked or disabled?
answer: Accounts are locked automatically after 5 consecutive failed login attempts to protect against unauthorized access. Check your email for an account unlock link or wait 30 minutes for the lockout to expire.

question: Where can I view active sessions and logged-in devices?
answer: Under Settings > Security > Active Sessions, you can view all devices, locations, and browsers currently logged into your account, and click 'Sign Out All Other Devices' if needed.

question: Does the platform support Single Sign-On (SSO)?
answer: Yes, Single Sign-On (SSO) using SAML 2.0 and OIDC (including Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Google Workspace) is supported on the Enterprise plan.

question: How do I update my profile name and photo?
answer: Go to Settings > Profile. Here you can upload a profile picture (PNG or JPG under 5MB), update your display name, job title, and time zone, then click 'Save Changes'.

question: What should I do if I suspect my account was compromised?
answer: Immediately change your password, click 'Sign Out of All Sessions' in Security settings, enable Two-Factor Authentication, and contact our security team at security@example.com.

question: What pricing plans do you offer?
answer: We offer three plans: Free (essential features for up to 3 members), Pro ($12/user/month for growing teams with advanced analytics), and Enterprise (custom pricing for high-scale organizations with dedicated support).

question: What payment methods are accepted?
answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and bank wire transfers for annual Enterprise accounts.

question: How do I upgrade or downgrade my subscription?
answer: Navigate to Billing > Plans. Select your new plan tier. Upgrades take effect immediately with prorated charges, while downgrades take effect at the conclusion of your current billing cycle.

question: Where can I download past invoices and receipts?
answer: You can find and download VAT/GST compliant PDF invoices by visiting Settings > Billing > Invoice History. Click 'Download PDF' next to any billing period.

question: How do I cancel my paid subscription?
answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Manage Subscription and click 'Cancel Subscription'. You will keep full access to your paid features until your current prepaid billing term ends.

question: Do you offer annual billing discounts?
answer: Yes! Choosing annual billing gives you a 20% discount compared to paying month-to-month. You can switch to annual billing anytime in your Billing settings.

question: Do you offer non-profit or student discounts?
answer: Yes, registered 501(c)(3) non-profit organizations, educational institutions, and verified students are eligible for a 50% discount. Apply via our Education and Non-Profit form.

question: What happens if a subscription renewal payment fails?
answer: If a renewal payment fails, our system retries the charge 3 times over 7 days. You will receive email alerts. If payment is not completed after 7 days, the account is temporarily paused.

question: How do I update my credit card or billing address?
answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Payment Methods. Click 'Edit' or 'Add New Card' to enter updated credit card numbers and billing address information.

question: What is your refund policy?
answer: We provide a 30-day money-back guarantee for software subscriptions and physical products. If you are not satisfied with your purchase, contact support within 30 days for a full refund.

question: How long does a refund take to appear in my account?
answer: Once approved, refunds are processed within 3-5 business days. Depending on your bank or credit card provider, it may take an additional 5-10 business days for the funds to reflect on your statement.

question: Can I get a refund if I forgot to cancel before auto-renewal?
answer: Yes. If your annual or monthly subscription renewed automatically and you contact us within 7 days of the renewal charge without using the service, we will grant a full courtesy refund.

question: How do I track my order or package shipment?
answer: Once your order is shipped, we send an email with the tracking number and a courier tracking link (FedEx, UPS, or DHL). You can also track your package in your account under 'My Orders'.

question: What are your standard delivery shipping times?
answer: Standard domestic delivery takes 3-5 business days. Express overnight shipping takes 1-2 business days. International deliveries generally take 7-14 business days depending on customs.

question: Can I change my delivery shipping address after placing an order?
answer: You can update your shipping address within 1 hour of placing the order from 'My Orders'. After 1 hour, your package enters fulfillment and address changes cannot be guaranteed.

question: Do you offer international shipping worldwide?
answer: Yes, we ship to over 120 countries worldwide. Applicable international shipping rates and customs duties are calculated at checkout based on your destination country.

question: What should I do if my package is marked delivered but not received?
answer: First check around your entrance and with neighbors. If your parcel cannot be found within 24 hours of delivery status, email support@example.com with your order number for a replacement.

question: What should I do if my items arrived damaged or defective?
answer: Take photos of the damaged item and packaging within 48 hours of delivery. Email the pictures and order number to support@example.com, and we will issue an immediate free replacement.

question: Can I use keyboard shortcuts to navigate faster?
answer: Yes! Press 'Cmd + K' on Mac or 'Ctrl + K' on Windows to open the Quick Command Palette. Press '?' anytime to view the full list of keyboard shortcuts.

question: Is dark mode theme available in the application?
answer: Yes. Click your profile avatar in the upper right corner and toggle theme preferences between 'Light', 'Dark', or 'Sync with System Settings'.

question: How do I export my workspace data and files?
answer: Go to Settings > Data Management > Export Workspace. You can export all projects, tasks, and chat history in JSON, CSV, or PDF formats. You will receive an email download link.

question: Can I work offline without an internet connection?
answer: Yes, our desktop and mobile apps support offline mode. Any changes you make while offline are stored locally and automatically sync to the cloud once an internet connection is re-established.

question: Does the platform integrate with Slack and Microsoft Teams?
answer: Yes! We offer official native integrations with Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Drive, Jira, GitHub, and Zapier. Visit Settings > Integrations to connect your tools.

question: How do file attachments and storage limits work?
answer: Free plans include 5 GB of cloud storage. Pro plans include 100 GB of storage per user, and Enterprise plans offer unlimited storage. The maximum single file upload size is 2 GB.

question: How do I set up notification preferences?
answer: Visit Settings > Notifications. You can customize email notifications, desktop browser popups, and mobile push alerts for mentions, replies, and task assignments.

question: Where can I find the REST API documentation?
answer: Complete developer documentation, code samples, and OpenAPI schemas are available at https://docs.example.com/api. Standard API rate limits are 1,000 requests per minute.

question: How do I generate and manage API keys?
answer: Go to Settings > Developer > API Keys. Click 'Generate New API Key', name your token, and save the secret key securely. You can revoke tokens anytime.

question: Are webhooks supported for real-time events?
answer: Yes, we support HTTPS webhooks for events like user creation, payment success, order updates, and message posts. Configure webhook URLs under Settings > Developer > Webhooks.

question: What SDKs and programming languages are officially supported?
answer: We maintain official SDKs for Python (`pip install example-sdk`), Node.js/TypeScript (`npm install @example/sdk`), Go, and Java, plus community SDKs for PHP and Ruby.

question: Where can I check system uptime and server status?
answer: Live platform uptime, scheduled maintenance, and incident history are publicly monitored 24/7 at https://status.example.com.

question: How is customer data encrypted and protected?
answer: All data in transit is encrypted with TLS 1.3, and data at rest is secured using AES-256 encryption. Our infrastructure is hosted in ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certified data centers.

question: Is the platform GDPR and CCPA compliant?
answer: Yes, we are fully compliant with GDPR, CCPA, and global privacy standards. Users have full rights to access, export, or delete their personal data at any time.

question: Do you support HIPAA compliance and sign Business Associate Agreements (BAA)?
answer: Yes, HIPAA compliance and signed Business Associate Agreements (BAA) are available for healthcare customers on the Enterprise tier.

question: How can I contact human customer support?
answer: You can reach our customer support team 24/7 via the live chat widget at the bottom right corner of the dashboard, or by emailing support@example.com. Enterprise plans also include dedicated phone support.

question: What are your customer support working hours?
answer: Live chat and email support are available 24/7, 365 days a year. Dedicated phone support for Enterprise clients is available Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST.

question: Where can I suggest new features or submit product feedback?
answer: We welcome customer suggestions! You can share your ideas and upvote upcoming features on our public feedback board at https://feedback.example.com or post in our community forum.
